utility.notes: San Francisco is served by PG&E for electric transmission and distribution; the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission (SFPUC) separately serves a limited set of municipal/institutional customers (not general residential customers), and CleanPowerSF (also operated by SFPUC) is the default generation supplier riding on PG&E's delivery infrastructure.

value.name: CleanPowerSF
value.notes: CleanPowerSF, operated by the San Francisco Public Utilities Commission (SFPUC), is the default electricity generation provider for San Francisco (except customers already directly served by SFPUC). PG&E continues to own and operate the electric grid, deliver electricity, and issue a single combined monthly bill that includes CleanPowerSF's generation charges in place of PG&E's own generation charges.
